title: Shared character analyzer, retained hand-transfer escape and cursor drag reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Same-holder physical hand transfer preserves the original portable escape operation and start tick through original-body release; denied transfer retains custody and real drop/re-pickup cancels the original operation.
Transfer refresh reuses owner-local active custody, verified commit success and a fresh strict release snapshot without a parallel registry or weakened release checks.

Mouse analyzer state consumes resolved medical state, species consumes inherited typed Species composition with humanoid fallback, and detached native portraits preserve synced appearance and cache invalidation without mutating the patient.

Screen-owned cursor drags reconcile exact captured sources against settled authority before paint and admission; escaped/removed/replaced sources clear rather than rendering a missing proxy, and valid drags remain.
Fresh focused JVM, full native, affected UI/interaction/prediction readiness, isolated client bootstrap and packaging pass; connected GPU portraits/cursor and physical input remain owner tests.
manual_steps: Pick up an AI mouse and repeatedly move it between hands while it escapes: the same five-second attempt should complete. A real drop and re-pickup must not retain the old attempt.
Drag a mouse icon under the cursor until it escapes: the stale drag should disappear without purple/black texture or a phantom drop. Check unchanged normal item drags too.
Scan healthy, critical and dead mice: verify real state, Mouse species and visible matching-variant portrait. Compare a human and pig, and confirm held-camera motion remains smooth.
